newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Citibank, Empire East sign office project.
newsitem.headline: Citibank, Empire East sign office project.

text.p: Citicorp unit Citibank N.A. and Empire East Landholdings Inc said on Tuesday they had signed a memorandum of agreement for a joint office project in the Philippine capital's Quezon City district.
Empire East corporate secretary Enrique Santos Sy said the 19-storey Citibank building will cost an estimated 800 million pesos.
Citibank is one of 14 foreign banks operating with full-banking licences in the Philippines. Its new building is designed to meet the expanding requirements if its credit card operations, Sy said.
Construction is expected to start in the second half of this year, he said.
The agreement will have to be ratified by Citibank's head office in New York and would be subject to approval by the Philippine Central Bank.
